title: About 6.3 million people could lose SNAP benefits due to proposed changes - ABC13 Houston
text:
SNAP benefits changes: About 6.3 million could lose coverage amid new USDA update - ABC13 Houston 
 24/7 Live Houston Southwest Southeast Northwest Northeast SNAP benefits 
 About 6.3 million people could lose SNAP benefits due to proposed changes 
 Tuesday, November 10, 2026 9:52PM 
 Watch Eyewitness News and ABC13 originals around the clock Millions more Americans could lose their Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits under a new rule proposed by the Trump Administration.
 The rule, which was proposed on Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, was published by the U.S. Department of Agriculture, which says states will no longer be able to grant automatic enrollment to groups who may qualify for other benefits, like Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF).
 The USDA said the changes would mean nearly 18% of current SNAP recipients would be cut from the rolls.
